title: A principal open of a quotient spectrum has a closed presentation over a normal domain with separably closed fraction field
statement: Let R be a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] with separably closed fraction field [def-pc-separably-closed]. For an ideal I of R and h in R/I, there exists a normal domain S with separably closed fraction field and a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] from the open subscheme D(h) of Spec(R/I) [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-open-immersion] into Spec S. This includes empty D(h) and I = R.

source.place: Lemma 09ZC, proof third and fourth sentences; the empty-open case is written out.

proof.text: Lift h to f in R using Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective. If f = 0, the open subscheme D(h) is empty. Its unique morphism to Spec R is a closed immersion, so choose S = R. The Lean proof constructs its IsEmpty instance and uses isInitialOfIsEmpty.

If f is nonzero, let S = Localization.Away f. powers f lies in nonZeroDivisors R, giving an integral domain and integral closedness. Construct S to FractionRing R by IsLocalization.map and use IsFractionRing.isFractionRing_of_isLocalization. Transfer separable closedness to FractionRing S along FractionRing.algEquiv.

The map Localization.awayMap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) f is surjective: in awayMap_surjective_iff choose a lift b of a in R/I and exponent zero. Therefore its spectrum morphism is a closed immersion by IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective. Compose it with basicOpenIsoSpecAway.hom for h to obtain the required closed immersion. Localization-quotient commutation is not needed.
